tiers.req: Bonfire unlocked and lit, fuelled with Chadcoal.
Heat 300: Basic heat. Removes Chilled from Act 2 zones 1-4.
Heat 1,100: Advanced heat. Removes Chilled from Act 2 zones 5-8.
Heat 2,100: Expert heat. Removes Chilled from Act 2 zones 9-12.
Heat 3,100: Fiery Weapon (x1.5 ATK multiplier in heated zones).

The one-time Act 2 boss sacrifices completed: Mammoth Bitusk, Jötunn Eye and Maevath's Horn are the unlock items listed by EvitaniaOnlineDB. Which items the game asks for, and what Maevath gives the Bonfire, are unverified in game; see Sacrifice 'Boss items'.

tables.title: Bonfire rules
rows: Do not burn raw logs. An Ironwood Log is 100 fuel, Chadcoal 1,100, a Palm Tree Log 500 and a Palm Face 26,000. Regular Act 1 coal is not a fuel.
With Smeltery Multicraft maxed, 10 Ironwood gives 3 Chadcoal: 3,300 fuel instead of 1,000 as logs.
Higher burn gives more heat but a worse fuel-to-ash ratio. Use 25-50% if you refuel once or twice a day; 100% only if you refuel often. Keep enough fuel to last until your next visit.
Base fuel capacity is 150,000; each Maximum Fuel rank in the ash tree adds 10,000.
A bonus applies only while its heat is reached. It stays applied offline if the heat was active when you logged off.
Chilled is the Act 2 zone debuff that heat removes.
Hourglasses do not add passive (fuel) ash; they do add ash per kill.
Sacrifice bonuses work on every map. Heat bonuses work only in Act 2.
Maximum heat rises with the one-time boss sacrifices; see Sacrifice 'Boss items' for the unverified item requirements. A higher flame makes ash faster but burns more fuel.
The Nice Heat achievement needs the burn slider at exactly 69%.
Fire Elemental zone: a Warrior standing in the middle of the top floor cleaves both platforms.

tables.title: Heat bonuses
rows: The Bonfire has a chance to produce ash every second
+1 base HP regen in heated zones
Monster respawn time -20% in heated zones
x1.5 ATK multiplier in heated zones
